title: An acoustic study on monophthongs in Central Australian Aboriginal English
why_promising: Primary conversational recordings from six L1 Central Australian Aboriginal English speakers contain 1,836 manually annotated monophthong tokens with explicit acoustic boundary criteria and 5-point F1-F4/duration extraction.
open_question: Locate a genuinely public token-level data or annotation deposit. The article and ANU publication record establish manual provenance, but the current crawl did not find an openly downloadable acoustic dataset; do not include until public accessibility is established.
